The control trial of wide-ranging and organically disseminated cyber-physical systems is intended to be sturdy and consistent with very multifaceted disseminated in addition to the vital controller. The safety difficulties in addition protective measures the aforementioned aspects are progressively advancing the concentration of exploration in the arena. This paper presents a study of different application framework that is helpful to industry and academia in the direction of design a strong security framework to improve these systems.

articleTitle: A Non-invasive Way Of Diagnosing Diabetes Based On The Heart Beat Rate
publicationTitle: 2020 Fourth International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: Diabetes Mellitus is a disease, which causes “sudden death in bed”. In previous years, diabetes is a rare disease. Due to the changes in food habits and lifestyle in recent decades, this disease has become common. Even children at birth are having diabetes. When the body doesn’t produce enough insulin or it can use its own insulin results in an increase of blood glucose level in the body. Blood glucose level measurement techniques involve the invasive methods that cause major and minor difficulties to the patients. To overcome this reason, a costeffective non-invasive method for identification of diabetes is presented, where the patient’s heartbeat rate is measured. Whenever there is an increase in the blood glucose level, the heartbeat also gets increased, resulting in the chances of diabetes. Based on the heartbeat rate the different types of diabetes can be identified. Once the diabetes is detected the patient can continuously monitor the level of diabetes with the help of data stored in the database. In the future, this data can be shared with the physician for regular consultancy.

articleTitle: Reduction of Various Harmonic Resonances in a Power Distribution System by Current Control Method
publicationTitle: 2020 Fourth International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: In distribution line, the use of modern power electronic devices generates the harmonics in current waveform. These harmonics may effect on the life of sensitive equipment’s at the consumer end. Hence, to decrease the harmonics at distribution line, shunt active filter are used as conductance. The harmonics are suppressed with the use of active filter in conductance mode. In DSP (Digital Signal Processing), shunt active filter work as an admittance with performing phase lagging mode. In that system use of the active filter in parallel tuned at harmonic frequencies to operate as in conductance mode. The damping performance can be obtained by adjusting conductance at dominant frequency. The paper presents the harmonic effects in the distribution line. The filter is operated with conductance mode. As compared to other process, active filter with resonance control gives high-quality results as compared to remaining. The proposed system was implemented in matlab/simulink to check the efficiency of the projected method. Simulation results displayed that by using AFU total harmonic distortions are reduced and by using controller distortion voltages are compensated by the controller using conductance command.

articleTitle: PSO Based Integral Backtepping Control for Leader-Follower Quadrotors
publicationTitle: 2020 Fourth International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: This paper focuses on implementation of an integral backstepping controller(IBS) for formation flying of quadrotor UAVs that follow a leader follower architecture. The controller gains for the leader and followers are optimized with Particle Swarm optimization (PSO) as manual tuning becomes tedious with increasing number of followers.The optimization technique minimizes the absolute error in tracking and reduces the magnitudes of control inputs given to the system. The simulation results on the performance of leader follower formation flight with and without PSO highlight the effect of PSO on system performance.

articleTitle: Image Feature Recognition Algorithm for Rural Revitalization Product Design based on Visual Attention Model
publicationTitle: 2020 Fourth International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: Image feature recognition algorithm for the rural revitalization product design based on the visual attention model is designed in this research. The magnitude of its saliency is generally represented by an image. In recent year’s research, the visual attention model has been used in various scenarios. Hence, this paper integrates the image data mining, visual attention analysis and feature extraction technologies to construct the novel framework for the visualized design for the product. These noises not only reduce the image quality but also affect the subsequent image processing, so it is particularly important to denoise the image in preprocessing, we use the neural network based denoising model to help build the robust system for the image analysis. The experiment validates and tests the performance and robustness.

articleTitle: Data Sensing based Inventive System for Multimedia and Sensing of Web Applications
publicationTitle: 2020 Fourth International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: In order to improve the data transmission ability of English situational guiding under the Web applications with the aid of multimedia network, inventive system for multimedia and the sensing based Web-English situational guiding scenario is presented in this manuscript. A multi-media assisted network for English situational guiding is constructed, a topology model of modern English situational guiding multimedia aided network is constructed, and a multi-media routing protocol for English situational guiding is established by using the flood flooding mechanism of hierarchical orientation. The level, density and residual energy of the multimedia network nodes are calculated to realize the optimal deployment of the nodes in the English situational guiding multimedia assisted network. According to the network hierarchy and the distribution of multimedia nodes, the design of English situational guiding multimedia network routing detection is implemented. In the simulation, we compare the proposed model with the state-of-the-art approaches. The result proves the efficiency of the model.

articleTitle: Machine Learning based Analysis of Influence Propagation on Social Network with Time Series Analysis
publicationTitle: 2020 Fourth International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: The influence propagation between the nodes is the key research area for detecting the online communities in the available dense social network. The analysis of influence propagation with time series analysis and measuring the centrality between the nodes will significantly increase the metrics of social network. The source node is dedicated to find the required information about the node links. The empirical results were discussed in this paper. Betweenness and centrality of influential node prorogation has identified users in the community and analyzes how the information has exchanged with different time ranges. With unsupervised learning, time ranges are analyzed between 0.5s and 1s in the strong ties of the influential propagation node, and further the influential node relationship between the communities has been calculated by using the strong and weak links. We collect the user information on the online social network-facebook user data, performing some actions post, comments, share, tag, Hit Rate, and the time. From these we have analyzed the propagation between the pair of nodes and users community. It is observed that the influence propagation in the collected data, at a time ’t’ the node U1 which is a ego node of U2, the information was shared between them, if the interaction has performed in a symmetric manner, say at a time $t+\beta$, the action is propagated from U2 to U1. We observed that the interaction of the frequency of action with different content, U2 is indeed exerting the influence on U1. The dependency of discriminate paths was identified and compared with the results obtained from random walk model to deliver a satisfied result by using the proposed model.

articleTitle: Event-Triggered Control for Multi-Agent Systems using Consensus Protocol
publicationTitle: 2020 Fourth International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: Multi-agent systems (MAS) refers to a system that is made of systems. This group of systems promises to be more efficient than single individual systems in terms of reliability and capabilities. This paper suggests, by event activated control approach the consensus problem of a distributed multi-agent network consisting of single integrator dynamics. The event condition and the consensus protocol are developed based on only local information. The event-activating conditions are only checked periodically to decide whether to refresh the information states of the agents or not. The event condition is obtained by conducting convergence analysis based on Lyapunov method. Simulation results are illustrated to show the correctness and realizability of the suggested consensus protocol.

articleTitle: Build: Web Services based Source Code Editor Integrate with Community Question Answer
publicationTitle: 2020 Fourth International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: Source code editor have different features to ease and speed-up the developer works. This paper proposed the source code editor BUILD integrated with Community Question and Answer (Q&A) and stack overflow web service. While programming developer often came across the set of questions, programming errors, thus in order to find the solutions or resolving the errors developers take reference from the different online resources (Documentations, Books, Q & A Services) through web browser. This leads to switching windows between source code editor and web-browser. To reduce development time and effort, neglect web or internet distractions and to get the specific result to questions we form a community. we combine source code editor and community Q & a services (Stack Overflow, institutional CQA). We also understand different learning resources and development tool which preferred by the developers. Explains the important of the Community Question & Answer (CQA) services.

Author Keywords: Crowdsource knowledge community question and Answer services

articleTitle: A Compact 2-Port Ultra-Wideband MIMO Antenna With Modified Ground Plane
publicationTitle: 2020 Fourth International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: This article presents a microstrip fed 2-port antenna with Ultra-wideband (UWB) and multiple-input multiple-output(MIMO) behavior. The MIMO antenna has orthogonally placed flower-shaped radiators. The novelty of design lies in its design as all the unit cell elements of proposed MIMO antenna are orthogonal to each other hence no additional decoupling structure is utilized to improve isolation making antenna design simple and easy to fabricate. To provide UWB characteristics easily in the proposed design, the ground plane is modified by slotting it with a compliment of half radiator shape geometry. In addition, a rectangular slot is cut from the upper edge of the ground plane beneath the feedline to improve impedance bandwidth. The design is proposed using 50×25 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> FR4 Substrate having a dielectric constant of 4.4. The simulated results of the presented design provide a bandwidth of 3 to 12 GHz with reflection coefficients S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</sub>, S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">22</sub> very less than -10dB and the mutual coupling coefficients for respective antenna elements are observed to be less than 15 dB. The design also provides an omnidirectional radiation pattern with dual-frequency bands characteristics and wideband behavior. Moreover, the diversity performance of the antenna is performed in terms of ECC, diversity gain, and TARC. Simulated results are presented using Ansys HFSS and are in good agreement.

articleTitle: An Efficient Hybridization of Artificial Bee Colony with Levy distribution for Rare Itemsets Association Rule Mining
publicationTitle: 2020 Fourth International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: Traditional association mining models depend on a support-confidence framework, allows the generation of frequent rules depending upon frequent itemsets identified. But, the infrequent itemsets called as rare itemsets are generally ignored by those techniques regularly hold meaningful information in certain reallife applications. In this paper, a new artificial bee colony (ABC) with Levy distribution called the ABC-L algorithm for the optimization of rare association rules. In the ABC algorithm, the exploration capability of the onlooker bee phase can be improved by the use of Levy distribution. The ABC-L algorithm is employed on the rules generated from the Apriori Rare (AR) algorithm to optimize the rare association results. The presented ARABC-L method is simulated using a set of three realtime synthetic datasets of T20D10000k, T100D10000k, T1000D10000k are used. The simulation results ensured that the rule generation process by the presented ABC-L is simple and comprehensible.

Author Keywords: Artificial bee colony prior to Rare

articleTitle: Using Halbach Arrays for Improving Range and Efficiency of Contactless Wireless Chargers
publicationTitle: 2020 Fourth International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: This paper aims to improve the traditional wireless systems using Halbach array. Drawbacks of traditional wireless systems have been studied and it is found that one of the central problems with current wireless charging systems is its limited range and power transfer inefficiency. These greatly hamper the mobility of the system and causes inconvenience to the user. To improve this, use of Halbach arrays has been proposed which improves the directionality of the charger. A tower-like structure is proposed which can transfer power over longer distances than current wireless chargers which will remove the restriction of the charging device to stay in contact with the charger for efficient charging.

articleTitle: Network-based Anomaly Intrusion Detection System in MANETS
publicationTitle: 2020 Fourth International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: In the communication model of wired and wireless Adhoc networks, the most needed requirement is the integration of security. Mobile Adhoc networks are more aroused with the attacks compared to the wired environment. Subsequently, the characteristics of Mobile Adhoc networks are also influenced by the vulnerability. The pre-existing unfolding solutions are been obtained for infrastructure-less networks. However, these solutions are not always necessarily suitable for wireless networks. Further, the framework of wireless Adhoc networks has uncommon vulnerabilities and due to this behavior it is not protected by the same solutions, therefore the detection mechanism of intrusion is combinedly used to protect the Manets. Several intrusion detection techniques that have been developed for a fixed wired network cannot be applied in this new environment. Furthermore, The issue of intensity in terms of energy is of a major kind due to which the life of the working battery is very limited. The objective this research work is to detect the Anomalous behavior of nodes in Manet’s and Experimental analysis is done by making use of Network Simulator-2 to do the comparative analysis for the existing algorithm, we enhanced the previous algorithm in order to improve the Energy efficiency and results shown the improvement of energy of battery life and Throughput is checked with respect to simulation of test case analysis. In this paper, the proposed algorithm is compared with the existing approach.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Image Coding methods using Wavelet and Noise Shaping
publicationTitle: 2020 Fourth International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: The application of 2-D dual-tree-discrete-wavelet-transform (DD-WT) is explored which is oriented and superfluous over Discrete-wavelet-transform (D-WT) for image coding which is being critically sampled transform. Iterative-projection-based-noise-shaping (IPBNS) algorithm has been applied for image coding which is been investigated through DD-WTs. Image originality is being kept reserved by compensation of small coefficients by modification of large coefficient in DD-WT; since IPBNS is one of sparsifying method. Results are investigated and confirmed that DD-WT along with IPBNS algorithm for image coding is far more efficient than the performance observed with D-WT and D-WT with noise shaping.

articleTitle: Design and Modelling of a CSC Converter with a variable DC link voltage to drive a Brushless DC Motor Drive
publicationTitle: 2020 Fourth International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: The applications based on Brushless DC motors are rapidly increasing in both industrial and domestic applications. This paper concerns the design, modeling, and analysis of canonical switching cell converter(CSCC) fed brushless DC motor. CSCC converter is one of the advanced converter topology offering a variable DC link voltage enabling it to suit a multitude of applications. MATLABlSimulink is used to design and simulate the converter circuits. The modeled converter is employed to drive a BLDC motor and analyzed for different load conditions (Torque) and different DC link voltages to ensure the adaptability of the converter topology to suit a multitude of applications and conclusions has been drawn based on the analysis.

articleTitle: Formation Maneuvering of Mobile Inverted Pendulum Robots with Attitude Synchronization
publicationTitle: 2020 Fourth International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: In this paper, a formation maneuvering control is proposed for open loop unstable mobile inverted pendulum(MIP) robots to track a predefined trajectory while maintaining desired formation with synchronized attitudes. A connected undirected graph is used for inter-agent communication. A two loop control strategy is used to enhance the kinematic control to the actuator level. Simulation results are presented to showcase the performance of this approach.

articleTitle: Real Time Target Detection for Infrared Images
publicationTitle: 2020 Fourth International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: The paper focuses on the real time detection and identification of human in IR images. Regular RGB cameras cannot capture images well in different weather conditions as dense fog, rain and complete darkness. IR objects due to its heat signature properties are well captured by IR cameras. YOLOv3 model is used as base model for IR detection as it delivers high frames per second.YOLOv3 is fine tuned for enhancing the performance and generalization ability of the model with IR images. The fine-tuned YOLO model is trained with customized dataset of IR images. The model achieves good accuracy of 89.28 mAP with validation set of IR images. The performance of tuned model is compared with the original YOLOv3 model. The original YOLOv3 model (without fine tuning) provides poor accuracy with 1.3 mAP with same validation set of IR images.

articleTitle: Novel Approach using user based Similarity for Recommendation Systems
publicationTitle: 2020 Fourth International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: Recommendations Systems (RS) are widely used by E-commerce and other web sites to recommend items to its users. Collaborating Filtering (CF) is very successful technique used in many web sites for recommendation. Many hybrid techniques with collaborative filtering are proposed in recent years for increasing the performance of recommendation system. In this paper a new user similarity based algorithm is proposed for recommendation system. The algorithm is based upon similarity between the users. The proposed algorithm is applied on a sample data set and its performance is calculated. The value of Mean Absolute Error (MAE) for the proposed algorithm is very reasonable.

articleTitle: Enhanced Storage optimization System (SoS) for IaaS Cloud Storage
publicationTitle: 2020 Fourth International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: Cloud computing is an inevitable technology that leads to demanding business requirements, the cloud services of IaaS utilization are being expanded in the data storage space, which leads to an increase in the requirements of bandwidth. To reduce the storage space, the De-Duplication Compression (DDC) algorithm has been proposed to improve the storage and utilization of bandwidth in the Storage optimization System (SoS) through the elimination of duplicate files and monitor the IaaS storage utilization. The various types of metadata standards help to identify the respective file objects and the file data elements are linked with corresponding block can be clustering into segmented bins. The DDC algorithm is associated with a linked list structure to access the file on different parameters to classify the future file access patterns against the cloud storage. Based on user access frequency, the ranking has been determined to predict future usage based on file access patterns, the SoS system possesses a dashboard that can help the user to decide on the file operation. This system result has experimented with the real environment with different parameter simulation. The proposed SoS framework will decrease cloud IaaS space size up to 13.80% than the existing cloud storage system.

articleTitle: Energy Efficient Active Slot Neighborhood Discovery Protocol Using Grey Wolf Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 Fourth International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: The wireless sensor network’s neighborhood discovery is a tedious process, with incomplete information. In a dynamic situation where each node has an independent wake upcycle its hard to discover the neighbor without any correlation in their wake-up time. By utilizing the information from the donor node and by pro-active waking up on active slots, high energy is being utilized up. This phenomenon will still worsen when the number of nodes still increases. To eliminate this situation the energy-efficient active slot neighborhood discovery protocol is designed using the grey wolf optimization algorithm. The simulator performance discussed with the existing algorithm shows a drastic improvement in discovery latency by 30% and residual energy by 50% than the ordinary active slot-based neighborhood discovery algorithm.

articleTitle: Cascode Inductive Source Degenerated CMOS LNA with Parallel RLC Output Matching Network for IEEE 802.11 Standard in 45 nm Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 Fourth International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: The IEEE 802.11 standard is set of LAN protocols, and define the set of the physical layer (PHY) as well as a media access control (MAC) protocols for implementing the WLAN WiFi computer communication at distinct frequencies, inclusive of 2.4GHz, 5GHz, and 60GHz frequency bands. This paper presents high linearity and low reflection coefficient low noise amplifier (LNA), utilizing cascode inductive source degeneration topology, in 45nm CMOS process. The proposed LNA is simulated for working WLAN applications i.e., 2.4GHz frequency range. Implementation of the circuit design has been done in Advanced Design System (ADS) software. The low noise amplifier achieves high third order intercept point (IIP3) of 14.097 dBm, reflection coefficient as input (S11) of -22.627 dB, maximum gain of matching circuit i.e., 19.329 dB, reverse transmission coefficient (S12) of -39.539 dB with nominal noise Figure of 2.353 dB at 2.4GHz frequency. The LNA achieves high stability factor 1.808 from a 1V power supply.

articleTitle: Creation of Face for Aiding in Forensic Investigation based on Textual Description
publicationTitle: 2020 Fourth International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: In this work, we have developed a solution that will assist the police department in the criminal investigation process during drawing sketches of a suspect based on the textual description from a witness. We propose a deep learning implementation based on Generative Adversarial Network that consists of generator which generates an image based on text description and discriminator which validates the image generated by generator with the data set. We trained a subset of 400 images collected from the Labeled Face In Wild dataset. The description of images was taken from Face2Text data provided by Albert Gatt. The images generated resemble certain features mentioned in the textual description which can directly aid the cops or can act as an intermediary for sketch artists to work upon.

articleTitle: The Peril of Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2020 Fourth International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: The integration of AI technology is with the hope of reducing human errors, improving efficiency, and providing faster result. Nonetheless, research indicates that AI may become hazardous over time and would not perform the intended roles. To recognize the perilous effects of AI, the study draws from the dynamic programming theory developed by Richard Bellman. The study proves that while AI is programmed to do a useful task, a malfunction may lead to negative consequences of the entire system. It may also attract indirect consequences such as traffic jams. The best way to explain this correlation is via the dynamic programming theory, which asserts that as systems become complex, they may sway from their targeted objective. Computer-related dangers may emanate from the cognitive complexity of the system as opposed to the specific properties of which the system was meant to perform. The immediate risks of AI are autonomous weapons, although other long-term effects such as gradual replacement of humans by robots and AI drug addition will also result.

articleTitle: A Single-Phase Transformer-less Grid Connected Photovoltaic Inverter
publicationTitle: 2020 Fourth International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: Now a days, transformer-less inverter are using photovoltaic system linked with grid application as a consequences of the advantages of less price, lower size and more efficiency evaluate with transformer. The main technical challenge towards TL inverter is problem of leakage current which necessary to-be focused precisely and occurring between parasitic capacitor and ground. It is minimized to overcome circuit damage and EMI problem. The main aim of presented improved H6 transformer-less inverter is to control leakage current by keeping fixed voltage of common mode due to this increases the reliability of the system and also reduced the total harmonic distortion. This is accomplished by employing SPWM strategy. The efficiency of presented TL inverter is more by comparing with existing TL inverter. The illustrated topology was done in MATLAB/Simulink software.

articleTitle: An Internet of Things based solution for the open lavatory problem in developing countries
publicationTitle: 2020 Fourth International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: Open defecation is the problem of releasing human waste in an expansive place. It leads to many infectious diseases like diarrhea. One of the measures to overcome the above concern is providing open urinals wherever necessary. Though the corporation can provide open lavatories to a certain extent, maintenance of the same is still an unsolvable issue. Many reasons shorten the process of preserving it. Among them, the frequency of cleaning and sufficient supply of water for washing are the two important concerns. These two issues may lead to a foul smell. It not only irritates the people using the toilet but also creates discomfort for the people in the surrounding. To overcome these issues, an IoT based solution is proposed to overcome the above issues. The proposed method monitors the water level in the overhead tank and change of contents in the air, alerts the concerned person regarding the issue. This system may also help to automate the process.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of A Standalone PV System Under Dynamic Weather and Loading Conditions-A Case Study
publicationTitle: 2020 Fourth International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: Penetration of renewable energy resources (RES) in power system is increasing day by day because of their abundance, less environmental impact, least operation and maintenance cost. In present scenario, establishing a standalone solar photovoltaic energy generation is very important to meet the energy requirement of those sites where the electricity grid connection is not established yet due to various economic and geographical reasons. Power production from photovoltaic is less complex in operation and ascendable too. This paper proposes a MATLAB/Simulink based model of a standalone photovoltaic system for a small rural community of 15 house-holds situated in Sundarbans area. Actual typical meteorological year (TMY) data has been used to develop the model in MATLAB/Simulink environment. From the simulation results, it has been verified that the proposed model is exceedingly robust and can handle the dynamics associated to irradiance, temperature, and load demand.

articleTitle: Development of a Framework for Effective Surveillance and Human Intrusion Detection in Border regions covered with Dry leaves
publicationTitle: 2020 Fourth International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: Terrorist intrusion creates problems to the national security. The casualty induced by previous terror attacks against Indian Military Force in Pathankot, Uri and the recent Pulwama attack demands the need of developing a multi-sensing system for detecting the presence and movement of intruders in the border areas. Huge human involvement is needed for the conventional patrolling systems and the latest surveillance systems are equipped with high-tech and costly devices. Line of sight issues and high false warning rates are the major problem experienced by using any of this single technique. This lead to the need of developing an effective surveillance and human intruder detection system integrated with multi sensing approach and different technologies. The proposed system is a part of the PANCHENDRIYA framework, only for detecting a human intruder in the border region covered by dry leaves. This framework aims to reduce the work force and cost of the traditional border surveillance by integrating multiple sensors and various wireless technologies. Microphone sensor is used to detect the presence of human intruder in dry leaves through footstep signal detection and surveillance camera sensor is used for getting a clear evidence of the intrusion in the border region through visual information. The overall system performance is enhanced by integrating these sensors into a microcontroller development board with high computational capability. Once the human intrusion in border region covered with dry leaves is detected, then the system initiates early alerts.

articleTitle: Battery used in Evolutionary Algorithm by using Adaptive Current charging controller
publicationTitle: 2020 Fourth International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: In the presented paper charging of battery programmed to scale down charging loss occurred in a Li-ions battery for Electric Vehicle (EVs) has been investigated. This suggested adaptive-current analysis depends on the deviation of internal resistance of the battery is employed for this suggested charging programmed as an objective of the charge rate and (SOC) State of Charge. To locate the issues for searching the ideal current set of suggested schemes, an Evolutionary Algorithm (EA) is a form of problematic access, is enforced. A plan for choosing the number of the ideal charging intervals is also conferred, to obtain a settlement among the computational burden and loss minimization. The prime objective of this proposed strategy is to reduce the charging losses and to enhance efficiency through varying internal resistance of battery as well as by employing PWM switching for converters.

articleTitle: Development of a LPG Monitoring and Automatic Cylinder Booking System Based on Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2020 Fourth International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: In the modern society, Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG) has been widely used as a cooking fuel in homes, hotels and industries. However in many cases, LPG leakage poses a serious threat to the users and the society. There are several ways to avoid the damage because of the gas leakage but the best way is to place a gas leakage detector nearby the source. Apart from the safety issue, people also find it difficult to identify the amount of gas remaining in the cylinder which causes inconvenience in their work. Therefore this project proposes a flexible and reliable way of detecting the leakage of LPG, monitoring the amount of LPG available in the cylinder and provides the ability to book a cylinder by automatically sending the booking request via SMS to the distributor as required. This system is also capable of sending an alert SMS notification along with a buzzer to users to notify about the leakage to avoid major accidents. The advantage of this proposed system over the existing ones is that it continuously monitor the gas level and also offers quick response to the events and accurate detection of leakage.

articleTitle: Performance Assessment of Particle Swarm Optimization with Grey Wolf Optimization Algorithms for Clustering in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2020 Fourth International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: Wireless Sensor Network (WSN) comprises of numerous cheap and low power operated sensor nodes. The sensor nodes are randomly deployed in harsh environment which is highly energy constrained in nature. Clustering is an energy efficient technique which groups the nodes into a number of clusters. Each cluster holds a separate Cluster Head (CH) where the data will be transmitted to other nodes present in the cluster. The major issue in the clustering process is the identification of proper CHs with respect to several constraints like energy, distance, node degree and so on. In recent days, several bio-inspired optimization algorithms have been presented to select the CHs properly. This paper assesses the performance of two optimization algorithms namely Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) and Grey Wolf Optimization (GWO) algorithms based clustering techniques in WSN. The compared PSO and GWO algorithm has been simulated under a network of 100 sensor nodes in the target area of 100x100m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>.The investigation of the outcome of these algorithms takes place under several aspects.

articleTitle: Circulating Current Control of Parallel Connected Converters
publicationTitle: 2020 Fourth International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: Boost converters step up the input voltage given to them. They belong to the class of switched-mode power supply. Parallel connected DC-DC boost converters exhibit a large number of advantages including generation of high output current, increase in output power capability, etc. But certain problems arise during such a connection. Some of them include the rise of circulating current between converters, regulation of output voltage and undesirable load sharing. This paper investigates the effects of parallel connection of boost converters on load sharing and output current. The open-loop control and closed-loop control of boost converters is compared. The results and observations from the simulation and experiment are presented to verify the effects of parallel connection of boost converters on load sharing and circulating current.

articleTitle: Machine Learning for Object Prediction in Station-of-Things Environment
publicationTitle: 2020 Fourth International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: This paper put forwards the concept of Station-of Things (SoT) for identifying different vehicles types which are present in parking slot using Machine Learning (ML). The study in this paper uses the concept of Internet-of-Things (IoT) to represent a station (parking lot) containing a thing of interest (car) which can be homogeneous or heterogeneous, and is termed as SoT. Advanced research in communication, computation and sensors innovation has enabled to build intelligent SoT environment. SoT environment refers to a station containing an object or a thing of interest. This can be anything from occupancy of chairs in a study hall, vacant seats in auditorium, cars parked in parking-lot, books on a bookshelf, and so forth. Similarly identifying different objects like vehicles in parking slot, goods in warehouse, different furniture in furniture showroom, in above three mention situation different objects are of different dimensions but same system can be applied for prediction of objects by changing the dimensions of object in database of ML toolkit.

articleTitle: A Differential Evolutionary Algorithm for Image Segmentation of White Blood Cells in Acute Lymphoblastic Leukaemia Images
publicationTitle: 2020 Fourth International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: White blood cells play an important role by enabling a protection against any foreign substances or pathogens that enter inside the human immune system. The detection of the white blood cells is done by using the image processing techniques. The lymphoblast images are a slight modification of the white blood cells. It has nucleus, which is often large and lobed, and it helps to distinguish it with the other blood cells. In this paper, the differential evolution algorithm is used for the segmentation of white blood cells from the acute leukemic images. Differential evolution algorithm is an iterative process through which the solution gets improvised as the algorithm proceeds with less number of assumptions. The experimental results showed that DE was able to successfully segment the white blood cells.

articleTitle: Power Management Scheme For Standalone DCMicrogrid with Fuzzy Logic
publicationTitle: 2020 Fourth International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: In this paper, an efficient and robust fuzzy logic controller (FLC) has been advocated for improved power management in islanded DC microgrids $(\mu G s)$. The proposed model has been built in MATLAB/Simulink environment and it has been observed that the uniform power control is achieved with the proposed FLC than without FLC cases.

abstract: Error propagation of a random variable for a case of large uncertainty and nonlinearity is studied, for the first time, using the extended unscented transformation technique (EUT), which is an extension of the unscented transformation (UT)technique, by revisiting an example studied in the literature by Smith, Neudecker, and Capote-Noy (Report INDC NDS–0709, 2016). In this example, the first four moments of a nonlinear transformation of a random variable of single dimensionality are determined, using extended unscented transformation technique and compared with 500000 histories of the Monte Carlo (MC) method. articleTitle: Low Latency and Area Efficient VLSI Architecture of 2D Bilinear Interpolation using Brent Kung Adder Based Fast Multiplier
publicationTitle: 2020 Fourth International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: Real-time image processing has extended its applicability that includes significant domains like satellite imaging and medical imaging. Despite such massive usage, the prospect of real-time imaging throttles due to the scarcity of any dedicated hardware. The dearth of any available VLSI architectures for real-time imaging can be attributed to the computational loads of the imaging methods. The 2D bilinear interpolation is an important operation extensively utilized in image scaling, image inpainting, and also in the post-processing step of image registration. But there hardly exists any suitable hardware for real-time image interpolation. In this paper, an innovative first-of-its-kind VLSI architecture for 2D bilinear interpolation has been presented. Our proposed pipelined VLSI architecture is based on our proposed shift and adds based multiplier, which is mostly combinational. In our proposed multiplier, we have used brent kung adder, which is popular for its fast computation. Our proposed architecture 2D bilinear interpolation consists of only some adders, hard shifters, and negligible numbers of logic gates. The presented design is also time-efficient, in the sense, the critical path delay is only restricted by the propagation delay of an adder, thereby ensuring the satisfactory value of maximum operating frequency. As the design is made pipelined, naturally, the throughput rate is high. The power efficiency of our proposed design is quite natural as the design contains only a few basic combinational modules along with some logic gates. The proposed design is realized using verilog before being simulated using the Xilinx Vivado 1S.2 tool. The simulated design is implemented in the FPGA of the Zynq UltraScale+ MPSoC evaluation board for verifying its quality in case of real-time applications. The simulated results and the outcomes of the real-time onboard testing confirm our claim of hardware, time, and power efficiency.

articleTitle: Sensor node deployment in Underwater Acoustic Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2020 Fourth International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: The proposed deployment scheme works as follows (i) The node calculates the common reference point whenever it is in the communication range of at least 2 other nodes. If any node is not able to communicate with a minimum of two other nodes and can communicate with only one node than such node can only perform one-hop communication with the nearest node to remain in the network. (ii) The sink node triggers the AUV to perform the one-time random walk in the network to gather the data from all the nodes including the calculated common reference point. (iii) The AUV forwards this information to the surface buoys. (iv)The surface-buoy sends the collected data to the sink node to process the data. (v) The sink node pre-processes the data to remove the adjacent common reference points, unfeasible points, and the redundant points. (vi) The sink node computes the routing path based on the common reference point and triggers the mobile agents to deploy the nodes at the remaining common reference points. The proposed algorithm is validated with performance parameters such as network coverage, network connectivity and a number of nodes to be deployed.
